title: Census sessions read package and registry pages through their APIs, arXiv papers in full, gzip files and wiki remotes
goal: python3 _tools/fetch.py text URL prints the text of a single gzip-compressed file that is no archive and of a response sent with Content-Encoding gzip; a census session reads a PyPI project page through its JSON API, an npm package page through the registry, a Terraform registry azurerm page through the provider's docs on GitHub and an EC press corner page through its documents API (provider.raw_url); an arXiv abstract source also gets a read of its PDF; a .wiki.git source gets a git ls-remote line instead of a page fetch
